```blade
<div class="bg-white overflow-y-auto shadow-sm rounded-lg mt-4 w-full">
    <div class="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-2 border-b border-gray-200">
        <h3 class="text-xl font-bold">Notes</h3>
        @livewire('create-note')
    </div>

    <div class="-mt-10 overflow-y-auto h-full pr-4 space-y-4 bg-white rounded-lg shadow-md">
        @foreach ($notes as $note)
            <div class="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-md relative flex items-center justify-between p-4 space-x-2 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 transition ease-in-out duration-300">
                <p class="text-sm text-gray-600">{{ $note->title }}</p>
                <div class="flex items-center space-x-2">
                    @livewire('edit-note', ['note' => $note])
                    @livewire('delete-note', ['note' => $note])
                </div>
            </div>
        @endforeach
    </div>

    <div class="bg-white overflow-y-auto shadow-sm rounded-lg mt-4 w-full">
        @if ($notes->isEmpty())
            <p>No notes found.</p>
        @endif
    </div>
</div>
```
